items.claim: Ian Garry's only loss in his career is against Shavkat Rakhmonov.
items.quote: the only loss that Ian Garry has had is against Shavkat

items.claim: Ian Garry won the first few rounds against Shavkat Rakhmonov before Shavkat came back on the decision.
items.quote: Ian took the first few rounds. He got onto the front foot... Shavkat basically won on decision

items.claim: Fighting an opponent with a heavy grappling style automatically forces fighters to be defensive and move backwards.
items.quote: when you fight a guy who's got such a heavy grappling style, you're automatically like defensive of that, which means like you're going to start going backwards.

items.claim: Islam's only loss in his career was a freak occurrence.
items.quote: Islam's only loss was a bit of a freak one.
